observations: The page number «6» stands at the head of the page, centred, with a rule below it. L01: the chapter heading, in bold, centred; in the left margin «O 159v, C 42v,» beside it and «N 11v» beside L02, the folios at which the chapter begins in O, C and N.

L11: the 1 of the note number 15 is a sort of another design, an I with a serif at the head and at the foot, where the other figures 1 of the notes have a flag; transcribed 15. N02: «Ale{ov:x}», the abbreviation of M, Alex with a bar over the x. L14 and L20: the 28 years, «XXVIII», the solar cycle after which the weekdays and the leap years return.
The semicolon of L05 stands after the thin space of the edition (11 px measured).

critical_notes.evidence: the note numbers run 25, 26, 27 (L19-L22), and the apparatus has note 26 on «memoriter teneto» (N10, «26) memoriter teneto] tene O.»); the number after «teneto» is printed 21, which is already the note on «detrahendi» in L15
critical_notes.impact: the variant of O belongs to note 26
